description: App icon: a glowing blue mana crystal over a dueling card with a spark of lightning.
Boot splash: the game name over a wooden duel table with two card decks and a glowing mana crystal.
Font of all text in Korean and English; readable at small card text sizes and bold for big numbers.
Battle scene board: a top view of an ornate stone and wood duel table, a lighter play area in the middle split into an enemy half (top) and own half (bottom), dark edges for the hand and heroes.
Lobby scene backdrop: a warm tavern-like duel hall with candles and a big notice board, soft blur so panels stay readable.
Back of an enemy card in hand: a deep blue card back with a gold mana crystal emblem.
Portrait of the player hero: a young duel mage in a blue cloak holding a glowing card, front view bust, painted fantasy style.
Card art of ember imp: a tiny mischievous fire goblin with ember sparks; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Card art of moss guard: a stout soldier with a moss-covered wooden shield; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Card art of mana bolt: a spell: a bright blue bolt of mana flying forward; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Card art of gale hound: a lean grey hound running inside a gust of wind; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Card art of crystal turtle: a turtle whose shell is made of blue crystals; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Card art of apprentice scholar: a young scholar reading a glowing book; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Card art of blessing: a spell: golden light and a shield sigil falling on a warrior; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Card art of iron wolf: a wolf made of riveted iron plates; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Card art of dawn knight: a knight in white armor with a dome of dawn light around him; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Card art of herb healer: a kind herbalist holding a bowl of glowing green herbs; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Card art of ash wraith: a ghost made of grey ash and embers; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Card art of insight: a spell: an open eye of light above floating cards; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Card art of lightning lance: a spell: a spear of lightning striking down; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Card art of storm rider: a rider on a horse charging through a storm; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Card art of magma golem: a big golem of cracked black rock with lava; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Card art of war drummer: an orc-like war drummer beating a big drum; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Card art of firestorm: a spell: a storm of fire falling from the sky; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Card art of elder treant: an old tree giant with a face in its bark; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Card art of flame wyvern: a red wyvern breathing fire; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Card art of sky colossus: a giant made of clouds and stone with a halo of light; painted fantasy style, centered subject, works when cropped to an oval on the board.
Portrait of the trainee opponent Miro: a nervous young mage apprentice with a too-big hat, front view bust. Painted fantasy style.
Portrait of the forest warden Tara: a calm ranger woman with leaves and a wooden staff, front view bust. Painted fantasy style.
Portrait of the archmage Velloch: an old stern mage with a long beard and purple runes, front view bust. Painted fantasy style.
Lobby BGM: a warm, light tavern tune with lute and soft percussion; calm and inviting.
Battle BGM: a focused strategic tune with strings and a steady pulse; tense but not loud so card sounds stay clear.
Click of a UI button in every screen.
A card is put on the board: a soft thump with a magic shimmer.
A card slides into the hand: a short paper swish.
A spell card is cast: a rising magical whoosh.
A minion hits another character: a short heavy impact.
A hero takes damage: a deep crack and a grunt-like thud.
A minion dies and crumbles: a breaking crack with a fading magic sound.
A hero is healed: a soft bright chime.
A ward of light breaks: a glassy shatter.
A minion grows stronger: a short ascending sparkle.
The player turn starts: a clear bell with a light fanfare.
The end turn button is pressed: a solid wooden click.
The player wins the battle: a short triumphant fanfare.
The player loses the battle: a short low falling phrase.
A new card is revealed as a reward: a magical rising reveal sparkle.
An action is refused (not enough mana, no valid target): a short soft buzz.
Title scene of the boot with the game name over the lobby backdrop.
Lobby scene after sign-in with the opponent ladder.
Battle scene: the duel table backdrop under the board panel.
Loading screen of every scene transition.
Terms popup of the first sign-in.
Root panel of the lobby: record, opponent ladder, start, deck and option buttons.
Deck panel over the lobby: each card of the deck with its copies.
Option panel over the lobby with the account and document entries.
Root panel of the battle: heroes, board rows, hand, mana, end turn, hint and turn banner.
Result panel over the battle with the record, the reward cards and the retry, next and lobby buttons.
Pause popup over the battle with resume and concede buttons.
A minion lands on the board: it drops from large onto its place and fades in.
An attacking minion lunges toward its target and returns.
A character takes damage: a red flash and a small squash.
A damage or heal number pops large, holds and fades.
A dying minion shrinks, tilts and fades out.
A played card shows large for a moment, then fades.
The turn banner pops in, holds and fades.
A buffed minion swells with a green tint.
A drawn card grows into the hand.
The board shakes after a big hero hit.
The end turn outline pulses while nothing else can be done.
A reward card flips in large with a gold tint.
A healed hero glows green.
A defeated hero portrait swells red and fades.
A ward dome bursts outward and fades.
A warm white flash over the screen when the enemy hero falls.
A minion lands on the board: a low ring of dust and golden sparks bursting outward from its base and settling within about 0.5 s; one shot, warm colors that read on the wooden table.
An attack or damage hits a minion or a hero: a short burst of white-orange sparks and grey dust puffs spraying from the hit point, gone within about 0.4 s; one shot.
A spell lands on its target: blue-violet magic shards and glowing motes spraying outward with a bright core flash, gone within about 0.6 s; one shot.
A minion grows stronger: green and gold sparkles rising around it and fading within about 0.7 s; one shot.
A defeated hero portrait breaks: stone and glass shards with red embers flying outward from the portrait and falling, about 1.2 s; one shot, big enough to cover the 150 px portrait.
An attacking minion goes back to its place after the hit.
A pressed card, minion, hero or button dips and springs back.
The board jolts hard when an attack or a spell hits.
The board dips a little when a minion lands.
A changed attack or health number swells and settles.
A dark red flash over the screen when the player hero falls.

Frame of every panel and popup (pause, result, deck, option, terms, lobby side box, hint box, turn banner): dark violet #1E1A2B parchment center, carved gold #E8B84A filigree border with small corner ornaments; the center stretches.

Every button (end turn, pause, result, lobby, deck, option, terms): a bronze-and-wood plaque with a raised gold #E8B84A rim and a soft top highlight; hover, pressed and disabled tint it; the center stretches under the label.
Soft white glowing outline ring with a transparent center; code tints it green for playable, red for target, yellow for picked and gold for button focus.
Small name plate under card names, hero names, minion names and the mana box: dark wood #2A2238 strip with a thin bronze edge and tiny end caps.
Sunken frame behind card art and opponent portraits: an opaque very dark inset with a thin bronze bevel; it is also the clip shape, and the art is drawn a few px inside its edge.
Body of a card in the hand, the deck list, the reveal and the reward: violet #2A2238 card face with an ornate gold border, a slot for the art at the top and a text box below.
Body of a minion on the board: an upright oval (pill) frame of gold #E8B84A metal with an opaque dark center; it is also the clip shape, and the oval art is drawn 7 px inside its edge.
Overlay of a guard minion: a thick silver shield rim around the oval with rivets, transparent center.
Outline glow of a minion: a soft white oval halo with a transparent center; code tints it green, red or yellow.
Ward of a minion: a golden translucent shimmering bubble over the oval minion.

Frame of a hero portrait: a heavy gold and stone square frame with rounded corners and a small gem at the top, and an opaque dark center; it is also the clip shape, and the portrait is drawn 9 px inside its edge.
Mana cost gem on a card: a round faceted blue #3FA9F5 crystal with a gold rim; the number sits over it.
Attack badge on cards and minions: a round gold #F2C14E medallion with a crossed-sword emboss and a dark rim; the number sits over it.
Health badge on cards, minions and heroes: a red #D64545 drop-shaped gem with a dark rim; the number sits over it.
One mana crystal in the player's mana bar: a pale faceted crystal close to white so code can tint it blue (full) or grey (spent).
A card the player plays leaves its hand place and flies to where it lands (a minion's row place, shrinking to the minion size) or to the reveal place (a spell); code sets the end position and scale.
The end banner of a battle (victory or defeat, with the player's hero) pops in over the board after the fallen hero breaks.
A card the player plays is lifted and grows with its green glow before it flies to the board.
A landed minion squashes on impact and springs back to its size.
The ring of dust under a landing minion spreads out and fades.
A card or minion that cannot act now wobbles side to side.
The reason a press was refused pops in over the board, holds and fades.
The mana count flashes red and settles when a card costs more than the mana left.
A full screen layer fades in.
A ring of gold light bursts out behind a reward card as it turns over and fades.
A shockwave ring at a hit grows out fast and fades.
A quick warm white flash over the screen when a hero takes a hit.
